svg.title: comma four
svg.desc: FrogPilot (driver-assistance software for cars) device icon: the front of a comma four, a black device with a honeycomb vent and a recess at its top right, above a glass panel holding a small screen showing openpilot's driving view of a palm-lined street under an overcast sky, with a dark sedan and a black pickup ahead, the green lane lines and path, a green status light, and the driver camera.
